The remaining alternatives (Phomopsis = seed symptoms, Brown_Stem_Rot = internal stem browning, Soybean_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus = wrinkled/curled leaves) don't match the visual either.

The test image shows a young soybean plant with scattered, small, light green to yellow spots on the upper leaf surface - this is the classic early presentation of downy mildew. The Downy_mildew reference collage (especially the bottom-left panel) shows a very similar pattern.
